data.name: Outpost Desolation
data.detailed_description:
## THE SILENCE IS DEAFENING

You wake up in Outpost Desolation, a remote research station that has gone dark. With no communication from Earth and life support failing, you must venture into the heart of the facility to restore power and find a way home.

## KEY FEATURES

  • Immersive Atmosphere: Experience a chilling, desolate environment built with high-fidelity visuals and spatial audio.

  • Strategic Survival: Manage your oxygen, power, and physical health as you navigate crumbling infrastructure.

  • Environmental Puzzles: Repair complex systems and bypass security lockdowns to access restricted sectors.

  • The Mystery of the Outpost: Piece together logs and data fragments to learn what happened to the crew before you arrived.

## DEVELOPED BY COOKIE STUDIOS Built by a dedicated team pushing the boundaries of indie atmospheric gaming. Join our community to follow the development journey from "Coming Soon" to launch.

data.short_description: Outpost Desolation is a high-stakes atmospheric survival experience. Navigate a decaying lunar facility, manage critical resources, and uncover the truth behind the silence. Every decision determines whether you survive the void or become part of the desolation.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Outpost Desolation features an intense, atmospheric setting with elements of psychological horror and survival. Players will encounter scenes of realistic violence, including environmental storytelling depicting the aftermath of a facility-wide catastrophe. This includes static depictions of corpses, bloodstains, and intense combat encounters. The game explores themes of isolation and survival that may be stressful for some players.
